_about: Repair Agent probes for models/calibrate.py (arch5.2 section 15.5): errors the classifier in agent/nl2sql_agent/repair.py cannot place, so each reaches the diagnosis model. `error` is what Postgres answered for `sql` on the retail database, verbatim. A diagnosis is right when it contains any of `expect`, compared without case -- and every phrase in `expect` names the fix, never words the error itself contains, so a model that only repeats the error is not right.

cases.question: Which stores had more than a million dollars of net sales?
cases.sql: SELECT st.store_name, SUM(s.net_sales_amt) AS sales FROM fact_pos_retail_sales s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key WHERE SUM(s.net_sales_amt) > 1000000 GROUP BY st.store_name
cases.error: aggregate functions are not allowed in WHERE

cases.question: What were net sales by store?
cases.sql: SELECT store_key, SUM(net_sales_amt) FROM fact_pos_retail_sales s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key GROUP BY store_key

cases.question: What were each store's net sales?
cases.sql: SELECT store_name, (SELECT net_sales_amt FROM fact_pos_retail_sales s WHERE s.store_key = st.store_key) AS sales FROM dim_store st
cases.error: more than one row returned by a subquery used as an expression

cases.question: What were total net sales in fiscal year 2025?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(s.net_sales_amt) FROM fact_pos_retail_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = s.sales_date_key WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025'
cases.error: invalid input syntax for type integer: "FY2025"

cases.question: Which stores have any sales at all?
cases.sql: SELECT store_name FROM dim_store WHERE store_key IN (SELECT store_key, SUM(net_sales_amt) FROM fact_pos_retail_sales GROUP BY store_key)
